title: Infrathon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Real-World, Long-Horizon AI Infra Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.11995v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this work, we study whether frontier agents can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons. We introduce Infrathon, a benchmark of diverse, long-horizon AI infrastructure optimization tasks across different levels. We evaluate six models across 150 runs with 24-hour budgets, totaling over 10,000 GPU-hours. Our results show that model rankings vary with the evaluation horizon, while 135 of the 150 runs achieve further improvements during the second half of their budgets. These findings indicate that shorter evaluations can overlook both optimization gains and changes in relative model performance. We also find agents can discover solutions that outperform human-designed baselines: Claude Opus 5.5 increases the mean KV-cache compression ratio from $6.82\times$ with the human-designed Quant-VideoGen codec to $19.86\times$. translated_title: Infrathon：面向真实世界、长周期AI基础设施优化的语言智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们研究前沿智能体能否在长周期内持续改进真实世界的AI基础设施。我们提出了Infrathon，这是一个涵盖不同层级的多样化、长周期AI基础设施优化任务基准。我们在150次运行中对六个模型进行了评估，每次运行预算为24小时，总计超过10,000 GPU小时。我们的结果表明，模型排名会随评估周期的变化而变化，同时150次运行中有135次在预算的后半段仍能取得进一步的改进。这些发现表明，较短的评估可能会同时忽略优化收益以及模型相对性能的变化。我们还发现智能体能够找到优于人类设计基线的解决方案：Claude Opus 5.5将平均KV缓存压缩比从人类设计的Quant-VideoGen编解码器的6.82倍提升至19.86倍。对智能体轨迹的分析识别出任务违规、不可靠的测试以及过早……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Infrathon长周期基准，通过对六个模型进行24小时、累计超10,000 GPU小时的评估，发现语言智能体能持续改进真实AI基础设施，模型排名随评估时长变化，且智能体可发现超越人类设计的方案（如将KV缓存压缩比从6.82倍提升至19.86倍）。
en_tdlr: Infrathon, a long-horizon benchmark with 150 runs (24-hour budgets, 10,000+ GPU-hours) shows that language agents can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure, with model rankings shifting over evaluation horizons and agents discovering solutions that outperform human-designed baselines.
